title: Gravity
subject: Physics

English.simple_explanation: Gravity is the force that pulls objects toward Earth.
English.detailed_explanation: Every object with mass attracts other objects. Near Earth's surface, Earth's gravitational pull makes unsupported objects fall downward.
English.everyday_example: When you drop a ball, it falls toward the ground because of gravity.

local_example.text: A mango falling from a tree is a useful everyday illustration of gravity.
local_example.appropriate_usage: Use as an illustrative context, not as a claim about a specific farm or tradition.

culture_connection.text: Fruit harvesting can be a meaningful context for discussing why people should keep clear of falling objects.
culture_connection.appropriate_usage: Show this as a local-context draft until a community or subject reviewer verifies it.

common_misconceptions: Gravity does not pull only heavy objects; in the same conditions, objects accelerate similarly.
think_question: Why does a dropped mango move downward instead of upward?

reasoning_guide.correct_feedback: Good reasoning: you identified Earth's gravity as the cause of the downward motion.
reasoning_guide.partial_feedback: You named part of the idea. Connect gravity specifically to Earth pulling the object.
reasoning_guide.misconception_feedback: In the same conditions, gravity acts on both light and heavy objects. Focus on Earth's pull rather than only an object's weight.

challenge.question: Imagine that Earth's gravity suddenly became half as strong. Name one everyday activity that would feel different and explain why.
challenge.hint: Think about jumping, lifting, or falling.
progressive_hints: Think about jumping, lifting, or falling.
Choose one activity and explain how a weaker downward pull would change it.
Compare the same person with Earth's usual pull and with half that pull.
challenge.solution: Many answers are possible. For example, you could jump higher because Earth would pull you downward less strongly.

quiz_questions.question: Which force pulls a dropped object toward Earth?
quiz_questions.hint: Think of the force that makes a dropped ball fall.
progressive_hints: Think of the force that makes a dropped ball fall.
Choose the option that describes an attraction toward Earth.
